entries.title: Problem 1: Handshakes
entries.body:
At the first Mathematical Society meeting of the semester, every person shakes hands with every other person exactly once. In total, 66 handshakes take place.

How many people were at the meeting?

entries.title: Week 1: Handshakes
entries.body: Try it with small groups first.
entries.reveal: Count the handshakes for 2, 3, 4 and 5 people and look for a pattern. Each person shakes hands with everyone else, but every handshake involves two people.
